audit_only_reporting_snapshot.contract: Snapshot identity hashes canonical rows_digest, row_count, frozen reporting contract and V3 implementation tag. It stores no CLOSED rows. Scientific truth remains the atomic journal; recovery must rebuild from journal rows and reproduce the snapshot key and canonical payload exactly.

robust_reporting_alpha_stress.regime_grid: p in {.005,.01,.02} x missing in {0,.002} x predictable exposure rule in {adaptive,fixed8}; 10 campaigns/regime, horizon 600
robust_reporting_alpha_stress.conclusion: On this finite predeclared grid .02/.03 improves worst-regime mean delay by 9.8 blocks versus equal split, while equal split is slightly better on unweighted across-regime average. Robustness and average delay are distinct allocation objectives.

same_history_allocation_selection.valid_construction: For precommitted allocation-pair masses pi_k, multiply each candidate pair's two channel alphas by pi_k. The total of all 2K marginal error budgets remains <=.05, so all candidate pairs cover simultaneously by union bound and arbitrary post-data selection among the K pairs is safe.
same_history_allocation_selection.interpretation: Valid arbitrary same-history allocation selection has a substantial selection-complexity cost in this stress. Independent meta-data selection can avoid that multiplicity cost when available.
same_history_allocation_selection.public_source: Xu, Wang, Ramdas, Post-selection inference for e-value based confidence intervals, arXiv:2203.12572, EJS 2024
same_history_allocation_selection.source_scope: e-BY gives FCR control for selected e-CIs under arbitrary selection/dependence; FCR is not simultaneous coverage of both bounds in the selected pair and is not treated as a free substitute for the stronger pairwise simultaneous-report guarantee.

measurement_validity_rules: Never persist a simultaneous-bound cache as a second scientific row history; key it to journal rows_digest plus frozen contract/implementation and fail closed on any mismatch.
Choose the simultaneous-report alpha objective before live evidence: average-delay, worst-regime/minimax, and same-history post-selection have materially different optimality costs.
Independent meta-data may choose a fixed allocation for a later certificate; the same certification history may not choose its own alpha split without explicit selection correction.
Post-selection FCR control and simultaneous coverage of all bounds in a selected report are different guarantees and must not be relabeled as one another.
The decision-IUT remains alpha=.05 per channel and is not modified by any of these reporting-only choices.
scope_guards: All numerical stopping results are synthetic finite-grid stress using the frozen V3 statistical family, not production reliability/performance measurements.
Exact repository-module rerun remains desirable because numerical execution used an executable transcription of the frozen V3 source while persisted validators import the exact repository module.
The minimax result is only over the predeclared finite regime/allocation grid and horizon-capped utility; no continuum/global minimax claim.
No forbidden semantic inputs were read; public research was used only for the post-selection guarantee distinction.
